limitations: PNG files are inspected synthetic WGPU framebuffer exports from real native windows, not OS window captures or native input/accessibility/live Discord proof. Native computer-use failed with os error 2 and Orca was unavailable.
Capture uses existing synthetic wheel injection; native hover toolbar/tooltips differ between frames. No keyboard/scrolling behavior is proven by these exports.
Idle samples use the default-bottom dark 1400x900 compact timeline with message 500 media, without injected scrolling; screenshot captures use the scrolled text rows.
One fresh native process per revision, eight-second warmup, twenty nominal one-second intervals. Recorded elapsed times include polling overhead. No build/ZIP work ran during either valid sample.

CPU is percent of one logical core from TotalProcessorTime delta/elapsed time. WorkingSet64 is process working set, not private commit, GPU memory or Linux RSS. Settled value is median of last five samples.
One conhost.exe child was observed per preview process. Its CPU/memory were not measured and are excluded from the reported app metrics.
After sample has five nonzero CPU intervals versus one on baseline; both CPU medians are zero. This single launch pair cannot establish a causal improvement or regression.
Startup/complete-frame p95, GPU memory, live traffic, native keyboard/input/accessibility and other OS rendering were not measured.
